description: This file defines the AlphaButtonClickMask class, a Unity MonoBehaviour that implements ICanvasRaycastFilter to customize raycast hit detection on UI buttons based on alpha transparency of the sprite's pixel data.

classes.name: AlphaButtonClickMask
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour implementing ICanvasRaycastFilter to determine if a UI element should respond to raycasts based on the alpha transparency at the cursor position.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the component by retrieving the Image component and validating its texture for readability, logging an error if invalid.

methods.name: IsRaycastLocationValid
methods.description: Determines if the raycast at a specific screen point should be valid by checking the alpha value of the corresponding pixel in the sprite texture.
